title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 10: Mai Masaki
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．１０ ～真崎麻衣～
overview:
The Private Idol series finally reaches its 10th title! This time it's avex race queen Mai Masaki!!

Volume 10 of the Private Idol Disc series is a photo collection and quiz disc starring Mai Masaki, with photography by Kazuo Ito. Browse her photo album, learn more about her through an interview of 100 questions, and play mini games including a "look this way" game and a quiz.

- Photo Hall: photo album
- 100 Questions: Q&A interview
- Game Hall: "look this way" and a quiz
- Production credits

プラドルシリーズもついに10作目!今回はａｖｅｘレースクイーン真崎麻衣!!
